text:
jamie: Heads-up — getting multiple customer reports of 504s hitting hosted inference during spikes. Seems tied to scale-up lag
priya: saw the alerts too. Gateway logs show a bunch of upstream timeout errors at the same time window, 30s+
sre-oncall: can you paste the gateway traces? also which tenant?
jamie: tenant=acme-marketing. gateway trace id=gt-8a3f. sample log: `2026-02-27T14:03:12Z ERROR gateway timeout upstream="inference-pool" code=504 latency=30012ms trace=gt-8a3f`
alex: running `kubectl get hpa -n inference acme-marketing` returned currentReplicas=1 desired=10 for a while in the window, looks like HPA didn't scale fast enough
priya: is KEDA involved for that tenant?
jamie: yes, KEDA ScaledObject in front of the pool. I pulled the scaledobject: ```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-scaled
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: inference-deployment
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  minReplicaCount: 1
  triggers:
    - type: prometheus
      metadata:
        serverAddress: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc
        metricName: inference_queue_length
        threshold: "5"
```
alex: pollingInterval 30 + cooldown 300 + minReplicaCount 1 looks rough for bursts — that'll delay scale-up and keep pods down for cooldown window
sre-oncall: also noticed readiness probe for new pods waits for model init which can be 20-40s on cold. We need prewarm or faster init
priya: customer-facing symptom: calls pile up -> queue metric spikes -> KEDA polls every 30s -> scales but new pods take long to become ready -> gateway starts 504s
support-lead: customer escalated saying it started after they enabled heavier batching at 14:00. They provided repro: 300 concurrent short requests for 60s -> 50% request 504s
jamie: repro steps we used: `ab -n 300 -c 50 http://api.redwood/v1/generate` produced 30-40% 504s within 45s
priya: immediate mitigations: raise minReplicaCount to 3 for that tenant, reduce cooldownPeriod to 60, pollingInterval to 5. Also add a prewarm lifecycle hook that pulls model into cache before readiness passes
alex: sending PR to infra to patch ScaledObject and HPA annotations. Also recommend enabling pod warmstart with `initContainers` that fetch model shards to /kvcache on startup
sre-oncall: for hosted path, we can enable short-term overprovisioning for bursty tenants — add burstPool capacity and route high-priority requests there if token tier allows
billing: FYI customer saw higher token usage and also billed unexpectedly because retries piled up. We should check whether billing debounce doubled their consumption
support-lead: I'm drafting a customer message: explain cause (scale-up lag + model init), immediate mitigations (we applied temporary minReplicaCount 3 and lowered cooldown), and long-term fixes (prewarm, smaller pollingInterval, warmstart). Any objections? :thumbsup:
jamie: +1. Also logging action items: 1) apply ScaledObject patch 2) add initContainer prefetch 3) add a Prometheus alert when desiredReplicas > currentReplicas for > 30s 4) run load repro in staging with minReplicaCount=1/3 to validate
priya: I'll own #1 and #3, alex will do #2, support-lead will send the customer note. I'll attach the KEDA diff in the incident ticket
keda-bot: Note: recommended pollingInterval minimum is 5s for prometheus trigger; ensure Prometheus can handle increased scrape load
sre-oncall: tagging docs/ops to follow up on runbook updates for warmstart and burst routing
jamie: thanks — leaving this thread open until the patch is deployed and customer confirms. Will post patch link here when done
